plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official AACC 2025-2026 online catalog, 'Program Name: Planner for Transfer Studies (A.A.)' (Code AA.TRANSFER.STDS). Four terms as printed (TERM 1-4). The planner prints credit ranges for some slots: Mathematics General Education '3-4 credit hours', Biological & Physical Sciences '3-4 credit hours' (Terms 2 and 3), and Term 4 Electives '5-7 credit hours'. Recorded values chosen to reconcile exactly to the catalog's 60-credit total: Mathematics 3, Bio/Phys Sciences 4 (Term 2, lab) and 4 (Term 3, lab), Term 4 Electives 6 — giving term subtotals 16/16/16/12 = 60. Catalog ranges are preserved in each choice_note. ACA 100 slot: catalog prints 'ACA 100 - Student Success Seminar OR evidence of completion of 24 college credits' (1 credit hour). Concentration: minimum 12 credits in a single discipline or approved related-field grouping (catalog definition carried in the choice_note). transfer_confidence is 'core_only': standard AA transfer degree; AACC is a Maryland community college with no published TCCNS equivalencies, so tccns mirrors the local course code.

courses.choice_note: Catalog: 'Concentration Requirement. Select a minimum of 12 credits in a concentration. A concentration is defined as either (1) courses with the same three-letter course designation (i.e. BIO, ENG, GSS), (2) courses within the same field of interest, as defined by AACC's Fields of Interest, or (3) courses in related fields of inquiry including, but not limited to: PSY/SOC; CTA/CTP/CTS; BUS/ECO; ENT/EET/ACH; ASL/SPA/FRE/KOR/GER/ITA/JPN/RUS (World Languages); ANT/SOC; ANT/BIO; CHE/PHY/BIO/MAT; AST/PHY/PHS. Students may request permission via Academic Standards to customize their concentration using a combination of course prefixes not listed above. Physical activities courses may not be used to meet a concentration requirement.' (3 credit hours).
